full_llm_interaction_log.purpose: Choosing and generating a suitable toy dataset for MDTM reproduction
full_llm_interaction_log.prompt: Help me create a synthetic temporal document corpus suitable for testing MDTM, with evolving topics across epochs.
full_llm_interaction_log.how_it_helped: The agent designed a synthetic dataset with 50-word vocabulary, 3 topics evolving at different rates across 20 epochs, generating documents via Dirichlet-Multinomial sampling.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_modification: I reviewed the data generation code and adjusted the drift rates (0.95/0.05 split for slow, 0.85/0.15 for medium) to ensure visually distinct evolution patterns. I also verified the generated data had reasonable statistics.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_verification: I checked that the synthetic data matched the generative process described in the paper (Section 3.1) and had sufficient samples (50 docs × 45 words per epoch).

top_5_prompts.prompt: Help me create a synthetic temporal document corpus suitable for testing MDTM, with evolving topics across epochs.
top_5_prompts.why_important: The dataset design directly affects whether the MDTM method can be meaningfully tested. Getting the data generation wrong would undermine all subsequent experiments.
